Seasonal meze

Cypriot and seasonal meze with touches of Greek cooking, from an open kitchen where you can see what is being cooked.

House dishes

Rabbit with lemon, chicken livers with commandaria, chicken soufflé and stews.

Take away, delivery and events

Home cooking to take away or delivered with one phone call, and catering for private and social events.
